name: The Alleys
description: Takes place at night immediately following the No Mercy finale. The rescue helicopter pilot turns into an Infected mid-flight; Zoey shoots him, causing the chopper to crash in an industrial area outside Fairfield.After regrouping at the crash site, the Survivors navigate through a network of industrial back-alleys, warehouses, and factories until they reach the main road at Riverside Boulevard. Finding a bridge blocked by a military barricade, they fire an abandoned howitzer cannon to blast through the obstruction. Finally, they cross the bridge and drop down into a warehouse on the right to reach the safe room.
